rows.note: Use 啫喱 as the all-purpose spoken word for dessert jelly.

example.english: I like eating mango jelly best.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 sik6 mong4 gwo2 ze1 lei2

rows.note: Use 果占 specifically for a fruit preserve or jam rather than set dessert jelly.

example.english: This fruit jelly smells great on bread.
example.jyutping: ni1 zeon1 gwo2 zim1 caa4 min6 baau1 hou2 hoeng1

rows.note: Use 膠狀物 for a material or object with a jelly-like consistency rather than an edible dessert.

example.english: The test results show that this material has a jelly consistency and absorbs water.
example.traditional: 實驗結果顯示，呢種膠狀物會吸水。
example.jyutping: sat6 jim6 git3 gwo2 hin2 si6 ni1 zung2 gaau1 zong6 mat6 wui5 kap1 seoi2
